stem: Mr. Ortiz used similar triangles to make a design. Which statement about the triangles in the design must be true?

options.label: A
options.text: They are the same size and shape.

options.label: B
options.text: They are the same size but different shapes.

options.label: C
options.text: They have corresponding angles that are congruent.

options.label: D
options.text: They have corresponding sides that are congruent.
